_doc: Zekra mobile app version policy, read by mobile/src/features/updates (GET https://app.zekra.dev/zekra-app.json). minimumVersion: installed native versions below it are blocked by a full-screen 'Update required' gate until updated from the store. latestVersion: the newest version live in the store (Android has no public lookup API; iOS also asks the App Store). Optional per platform: storeUrl, message {en, ar}. Bump latestVersion once a store release is live; raise minimumVersion only to retire old binaries.
